scope: Selected full Linker virtual methods,cooldown records,original-owner routes and required ready-animation dependency

confirmed.contract: Cache admission checks attached bank row OR active bank;not IsShow or pin flags alone. Each free matching slot gets its own clock reading;occupied entries are not restarted.
Match wrapper virtual kind and code,then wrapper index against source item serial+4. Index,server index anddata-code are distinct comparisons.
Raw gate114A070 defaults0;nonzero gate suppresses the entire routine for kind1. Meaning beyond this behavior is not yet named.
Expiration uses unsigned DWORD(now-start)+offset>=duration. Even hidden/removed-bank entries expire and are cleared;ready cues are attached only for admitted/current banks.
Remove clears matching object pointer andstart timestamp only;bank/offset/duration remain. Expiration clears all20 record bytes.
Calls root CGUIContainer membership test with window+0x150+bank*0x3bc8. Active bank is an explicit separate exception.
Ready child at GUIItem+1040 uses atlas1/action13/frame0,128x128,8columns5rows,FPS34,no loop,initial stopped;blend mode3.
Animation Update uses source loopSeconds,Show/paused/stopped gates,strict pause elapsed>interval,frame spill then total comparison;one-shot clamps last frame andsets stopped.
Ready cue centered with signed integer (iconSize-cueSize)/2. It is a separate child attached towindow,not the radial timer or always-drawn GUIItem child.
Blend mode3 uses SRCALPHA/ONE and modulated texture alpha. Reusing existing alpha-only DrawSpriteUV would produce different output.
Original-owner lookup forphysical kind0 checks boards1,0,5;equal lookup502330 checks1,0. SF branches3/7,Animus4,kind6 board22,Macro7 board35.
Window messages use raw455 codes501/502/504/50c/510/512/3327. Legacy global enums must not be silently substituted.

Erase returns advanced iterator;the outer loop then increments it again unconditionally. Adjacent stopped cues can survive to a later frame;do not replace with a conventional erase-without-increment loop. End/sentinel unsafe domains remain open.

next_dependency: Implement source-owned CGUIObjectAni-compatible ready child and mode3 draw first;then wire real cache/FrameMove/remove/typedBegin andcompletehandlers. Current production098 remains unchanged.
